thread:
Rin (Design): dropped a compact-card experiment for the latency p95 + heatmap. Goal: make p95 readable at small widths, keep heatmap interactive, and add a one-line control bar with timepicker, sampling toggle, and copy CSV. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ghi789/latency-compact-explorations

Rin (Design): quick question: where should the copy (CSV) button live in compact mode so its discoverable but not noisy? left next to timepicker, or right aligned with kebab?
Soham (Eng): prefer right-aligned near kebab. keeps scan order left->metrics->actions. technical constraint: fewer focusable elements in the lead area helps screen-reader users.
Lina (PM): for incident responders, copy beside the timepicker is faster. They expect actions near the timeframe. maybe make it configurable (pinned cards show copy left).
Ethan (A11y): accessibility trade: whichever side we pick, ensure keyboard order matches visual order. if copy is visually left but logically tabbed later, thats confusing. Also aria-label: "Copy visible timeframe as CSV (max 10k rows)" and toast should be aria-live polite.
Rin (Design): good call. proposal: default copy on right, but pinning flips it left. that satisfies both cases. will show both states in the mock.
Soham (Eng): implementation plan: sampling control as a single icon with badge (e.g., "1/10") that opens a popover with presets and a slider. popover keeps tab stops minimal. copy uses navigator.clipboard.writeText(csv) + console-bot toast. add UI-side 5s throttle.
Lina (PM): microcopy tweak: replace "Auto-sample" with "Adaptive sampling" in tooltips and a11y text. users misinterpreted "auto" in tests.
Ethan (A11y): also add pattern overlays to heatmap legend for colorblindness (dots/diagonals) and make hover tooltips link via aria-describedby to a hidden label for the percentile (e.g., "p95: 120ms").
Rin (Design): will update figma with: icon+badge sampling, copy-right default + pin flips, adaptive sampling tooltip, and pattern legend. Also adding focus order notes and example aria attributes in the spec.
Soham (Eng): one more: emit telemetry events `compact_copy_clicked` with sampling_rate and `sampling_preset_changed`. low-cardinality props only. then we can iterate based on real usage.
Lina (PM): yes please. also flag the rollout behind feature flag for 2-week canary.
Rin (Design): thanks. will ping when assets are uploaded.
console-bot: uploaded 4 assets to staging/latency/compact/ (build 2026-03-24T09:20Z)
Ethan (A11y): happy to review the updated strings once posted.

Rin (Design): will do. end.
